motrune.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset: one finished square Motrune application icon, original Chinese mythological Bifang bird. Match the existing ZAOYU icon family through this text specification.
Primary request: replace the previous winged serpent with an unmistakably avian one-legged crane-like mythical bird; this is NOT a snake.
Style: warm parchment ivory #F6EDD7 creature, confident dark blue-black #142B32 contour lines, restrained detailed natural-history wood engraving, broad calm light masses and clean feather panels. Mature elegant vivid silhouette. Flat opaque muted violet background #535398, entirely uniform.
Subject: BIFANG 毕方, long straight slender ivory beak, alert visible round eye, small compact crane head, SHORT gently bent avian neck clearly attached to a substantial feathered bird breast, two broad feathered wings swept diagonally up and back. Exactly ONE clear long bird leg with a bent joint and one three-toed foot, entirely visible below the belly. No second leg. Three short tapered tail feathers, clearly separate from the leg. Clearly crane/heron anatomy, not an eagle, phoenix or peacock. No serpentine body or S-shaped snake pose, no snake scales, no reptilian head.
Composition: strong close framing as a desktop application icon, bird fills nearly the entire square but preserve ALL of the face, straight beak, head, neck, breast and its single leg and foot. Face sits inside the upper-left central area around x=32%,y=28%; eye, beak tip and head all comfortably away from any corner. One broad wing extends toward the upper-right and only the farthest feather tips may continue beyond the right edge. Other wing forms a rising motion curve. The one foot stays in the lower center at y=83%, with visible background around it. Exactly one complete identifiable bird, key anatomy fits within a rounded-square mask. Do not enclose the bird in a drawn frame or circle. This is expansive and energetic, not a tiny centered emblem.
Constraints: full square opaque canvas, no rounded corner mask, no text, letters, glyphs, watermark, logo, decorative objects, fire, clouds, scenic environment, drop shadows, glow, gradient, paper texture or 3D. Do not copy any existing character or icon. Output only one icon.

sonune.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset: one finished square Sonune application icon, original interpretation of the Chinese mythical Diting guardian.
Primary request: replace a one-legged ox with a clearly FOUR-LEGGED listening guardian, with unmistakable large ears and ONE horn. The subject must not be a cow or an ox.
Style: warm parchment ivory #F6EDD7 creature, confident dark blue-black #142B32 outline, restrained natural-history wood engraving, broad calm ivory masses, clear silhouette and sparingly used hatching. Match the ZAOYU mythical icon family. Flat opaque slate-teal background #3E6479, uniform across the whole square.
Subject: DITING 谛听, dignified compact quadrupedal guardian in side-three-quarter view facing left, a tiger-like broad face and gentle alert eyes, ONE smooth tapered central forehead horn, TWO exceptionally clear large soft dog-like ears with one ear raised listening and the other tilting outward, compact strong feline-dragon body with a few large scale plates across its back, FOUR distinct sturdy legs ending in rounded cloven hooves, and a curved lion tail with a small tuft. Keep face, both ears, single horn and all four feet visible and recognizably separate. Short ornamental neck fur; no huge shaggy lion mane. Expression attentive and calm, mouth closed. Large listening ears are the strongest identifying feature after the one horn. Not a bull, elephant, snake, ordinary dog, winged lion or modern game character.
Composition: bold close framing with a large foreground head and ears in the left-center of the icon and the body sweeping diagonally toward the lower right. Face and horn fully inside the canvas, horn tip around y=12%; muzzle around x=13%,y=40%; all four feet visible inside y=84% with clean spaces between them. The ear outline and tail tuft may approach or slightly cross a side edge, but DO NOT crop the face, horn or feet. Creature fills roughly 88-95% canvas width, a strong clear icon rather than a small creature floating in the middle. Rounded-square safe corners for important identifying features. No drawn frame.
Constraints: full square opaque canvas, no rounded mask, no text, letters, glyphs, watermark, decorative symbols, headphones, sound wave pictograms, book, halo, pedestal, scenery, shadow, gradient, glow or 3D. Output only one icon.
